name: adminapp
description: AdminApp — SaaS multi-tenant de gestion comercial. Monorepo: api + web + landing.

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix apps/api ci && npm --prefix apps/web ci && npm --prefix apps/landing ci
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web,landing -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:landing"
scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run build:landing
scripts.lint: npm --prefix apps/web run lint && npm --prefix apps/landing run lint
